title: Ἁλιευτικά, Halieutica (On Fishing); «Галиевтика» («О рыбной ловле»)
author: Oppian of Anazarbus
genre: Didactic hexameter poem on marine life and fishing
ru_evidence: ru.wikipedia 'Оппиан': only excerpts by Grabar'-Passek in Памятники поздней античной поэзии и прозы (1964), pp. 34–39.
value: The largest ancient poem on marine life. A source for ancient ichthyology, fishing technology and imperial court didactic poetry (dedicated to Marcus Aurelius and Commodus). Heavily read and annotated in Byzantium. Appeals to both specialists and general readers.
ai_feasibility: High. Clear epic diction. Fish-name identifications (Thompson's glossary) need checking. Mair's English allows cross-checking.
